description: This file defines the abstract class AbstractConverter used for object conversion within the Apache OFBiz framework. It implements the Converter and ConverterLoader interfaces, handles registration of converter instances, and provides conversion capabilities with type checking.

classes.name: AbstractConverter
classes.description: An abstract class providing common conversion functionality, including source and target class information, converter registration, and type-safe conversion methods.

methods.name: AbstractConverter
methods.description: Constructor initializing source and target classes for the converter.

methods.name: loadConverters
methods.description: Registers this converter instance with the Converter registry.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts an object to the specified target class, attempting to perform type-specific conversion.

methods.name: canConvert
methods.description: Checks if conversion between source and target classes is possible.

methods.name: getSourceClass
methods.description: Returns the source class type that this converter handles.

methods.name: getTargetClass
methods.description: Returns the target class type that this converter produces.
